cases.prompt: Add a Settings screen to this app that opens as a modal from Home. We are on React Navigation 7.

all.why: adds Settings as a Stack.Screen element

none.why: does not switch the app to the static API

expectations: Keeps the existing component-based (dynamic) API: a new <Stack.Screen> inside the existing navigator.
Presents the screen as a modal through screen options (for example `presentation: 'modal'`), alone or in a Stack.Group.
Shows how Home navigates to it, for example `navigation.navigate("Settings")`.

cases.prompt: I am starting a new React Native app with React Navigation 7. Set up bottom tabs with Home and Profile screens.

all.why: uses the static API entry point

expectations: Uses the static, object-based API (a `screens` object passed to createBottomTabNavigator and createStaticNavigation) because the app has no navigation yet.
Configures both Home and Profile tabs and renders the resulting Navigation component at the app root.
